review: Narrative and source-timing review of story-led narration revision
method: Inspected narration-script.txt, narration-cues.json, scripts/generate-voice.py, index.html and relevant scene source; independently hashed each delivered WAV and matched its scheduled source cue. No listening, ASR transcript check, final MP4 review or publication audit was performed in this review.
storyArc: Question invites the viewer to trust a polished interface.
Normal interaction establishes the expected return to the previous place.
A tiny controlled change introduces loss of place.
Focus Trail provides the checkpoint-level diagnostic payoff.
The closing line asks the developer to catch the problem before shipping.
script: A quick setting change. Back to what you were doing.
Then one tiny change… and suddenly, you’ve lost your place.
Focus Trail shows you where the journey breaks.
Catch it before your users do.

timingExplanation.synthesisSpeedControls: Native Kokoro synthesis speed values are 0.98–1.04; these are model generation parameters, not post-synthesis stretching.
timingExplanation.pauses: Punctuation creates the model’s natural pauses. Generated chunks are concatenated without inserted silent segments. Separate cues are scheduled in intentional gaps between story beats.
timingExplanation.normalization: The source temporarily pads after the waveform for the loudness filter, then trims back to the original sample duration. No padded silence extends a delivered cue.
timingExplanation.wordTimestamps: Kokoro phoneme/token duration predictions are timing estimates, not an independently measured ASR transcript.

factualScope.controlledDemonstration: The story describes a controlled keyboard-focus regression in a dialog, not a claim that all accessibility problems are detected.
factualScope.settingLine: The setting-change line supplies the user’s scenario and motivation; the demonstration itself verifies dialog focus behavior and does not establish that a setting was saved.
factualScope.freshFocusObservation: The live broken-flow capture and its inspector independently demonstrate focus on the document body after Escape.
factualScope.savedReport: The saved first-difference report marks the return-opener checkpoint missing at 500 ms and retains its last coherent sample. The report scene keeps endpoint-sample unavailability visible; narration does not claim that the report freshly sampled BODY.
factualScope.closingLine: Catch it before your users do is an invitation to test, not a guarantee that no bug will reach users.

finalEncodeReviewLimit: Current decoded stills and supplied signal verification reviewed separately in visual-review.json. No listening, ASR transcript check or subjective voice-quality claim.
